'''2007 Worlds Team Thomas E. Whatley LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas E. Whatley]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Sheet Whaley → Whatley. Team Texas. Murtt Doneeta / Rayc Rycar OCR. ~10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas E. Whatley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
